options.B: Peter criticized the early Christian community for their idolatry and lack of faith in God.
options.C: Peter called for the early Christian community to return to their ancestral traditions and customs.
options.D: Peter emphasized the importance of social justice and righteousness in society.

questions.stem: Explain the concept of 'suffering as a Christian' in the book of 1 Peter, highlighting its significance in the context of Peter's message.

options.A: Suffering as a Christian refers to the idea that one must endure hardship and persecution for the sake of the faith.
options.B: Suffering as a Christian refers to the idea that one must perform good works to avoid suffering.
options.C: Suffering as a Christian refers to the idea that one must follow the law to avoid suffering.
options.D: Suffering as a Christian refers to the idea that one must be baptized to avoid suffering.

questions.stem: In the Gospel of John, what is the significance of the miracle of Jesus turning water into wine at the wedding in Cana?

options.A: It demonstrated Jesus' power over nature and his ability to provide for others.
options.B: It showed Jesus' willingness to challenge traditional Jewish customs and laws.
options.C: It highlighted the importance of hospitality and generosity in ancient Jewish culture.
options.D: It marked the beginning of Jesus' public ministry and his recognition as the Messiah.

questions.stem: What is the main theme of the book of Judges in the Old Testament?

options.A: The struggle between good and evil
options.B: The importance of faith and obedience
options.C: The cycle of sin and repentance
options.D: The role of leadership in Israel
